text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Mejiro Ardan's debut race just around 
the corner and her final prep entering its 
closing stages—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —Yes. No problem.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Our debut race is just ahead... We cannot 
afford to waste a single moment, so—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...As the main event approached, Mejiro 
Ardan's intensity continued to surge 
without limits. She was the very 
definition of "fierce determination."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer. Could we go for one more?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
While my senses are still sharp and 
refined, I want to log as many miles as I 
can.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much. Well then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seems to be pushing herself too hard, 
but forcing her to suddenly dial back this 
intense drive right before the big race 
could be dangerous...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, I'll strive to channel this 
demonic intensity straight into the race, 
ensuring she delivers her absolute best 
performance...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAHHH!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Mejiro Ardan's final prep 
continued right up to the wire before her 
debut race—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And then, the day of the debut race 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A focus so profound that it rendered me 
utterly speechless. Just how long have I 
been watching her like this...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ――Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Thanks to you, everything is in 
order. I'm ready to run at any time now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much for training and 
forging me up to this day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Without fail, I shall show it on the 
racetrack. Everything that makes up the 
'me' of today."
choice_data_list: I'll see it through to the end.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Well then—I shall be on my way.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, that girl debuting in today's race, 
apparently she's the younger sister of 
that Mejiro Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see. Even so, Mejiro Ramonu, huh... 
Man, that running style really brings back 
memories.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
She's truly a living legend, you know~ 
Especially in races like the Oaks—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...This is the racetrack. Not the 
academy's training course, but a true 
battlefield. The feel of it, the smell, 
the wind—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(—My blood is boiling. My body is aching. 
No matter how hard I try, I can't hold it 
back...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...Transforming the heat that scorches my 
body into brilliance, to leave behind a 
single trail of light—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan, heading out.
